newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.629 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.629 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.629 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.685 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on April 10, raised 1,000.1 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.590 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on April 3, raised 867.35 million and was priced at 99.576 percent.
